NOT COVERED: the fake is not the upstream PyTorch simulator; it re-states the GymnasiumWrapper interface with placeholder scalar dynamics, no collisions, gravity, friction, joints, lidar, communication or rendering, and it has no vectorized batch dimension. NOT COVERED: cap.world.step.v1 carries one scalar reward, while GymnasiumWrapper.step returns one reward per agent; the fake returns the sum and the fidelity gaps say so. NOT COVERED: the wrapper's reset calls Environment.reset_at(index=0) and its step expects a list of per-agent actions; the bridge sends the Dict action keyed by agent name, so the fake accepts both. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of env_id vmas:balance) was not run: torch, gymnasium and shimmy are not installed here, and no such gymnasium environment is registered. G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. Expected warnings remain: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so the bridge makes no native call) and six G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs (seed twice, ticks and the three action arrays); declaring actions for them would replace the bridge's derived descriptions, the same residual the gymnasium exemplar documents. The fake's numbers are placeholder test data, never facts, limits or references.
